page.overview:
What is Now That We're Dead?

Now That We're Dead is the third song from Metallica's tenth studio album Hardwired...to Self-Destruct. It was released as a single five months after the album on April 18th, 2017.

The subject matter talks about discovering clarity, strength, and the importance of sticking together after something big ends—like a breakup, a false belief, or an addiction. It shows how this can lead to a new beginning instead of just an ending. The song explores ideas of love, loss, and overcoming destruction to continue living on in the afterlife or in people's memories, similar to a modern version of Romeo and Juliet, where they stay together even through tough times.

The first music video of the song was released on November 16, 2016 and was directed by Herring & Herring and edited by Jeremiah Bruckart. The second music video was released on May 31, 2017, featuring live footage from Mexico City by Brett Murray.

When darkness falls May it be That we should see the light
